en: Unyuuu... I really want some ice cream from this vending machine, but I don't have any money...
ja: うにゅう……この自販機のアイス、すっごく欲しいんだけど、お金がなくて……

key: ...Hey... Is that Vanilla Ice Cream you have there?
en: ...Hey... Is that Vanilla Ice Cream you have there?
ja: ……ねえ……それ、バニラアイス持ってる?

key: Hey... Could I have it? Pretty please?
en: Hey... Could I have it? Pretty please?
ja: ねえ……もらってもいい? お願い?

en: Yayyy! Thank you, thank you tons!
ja: やったー! ありがとう、本当にありがとう!

key: Imma go eat it outside, 'kay? Bye-bye!
en: Imma go eat it outside, 'kay? Bye-bye!
ja: 外で食べてくるね、いい? バイバイ!

key: Oh... It's okay...
en: Oh... It's okay...
ja: あ……いいの……

en: ...Hey... Is that Chocolate Ice Cream you have there?

key: What's your favorite candy? A bear?!
en: What's your favorite candy? A bear?!
ja: 好きなお菓子は何? くま?!

key: I want one of those!
en: I want one of those!
ja: あれが欲しい!

key: And those!
en: And those!
ja: それとあれも!

key: And that! And this! And-and-and-and!
en: And that! And this! And-and-and-and!
ja: それに、あれも! これも! それとそれとそれと!

key: Aaaaah, why can't I hold all these candies?!
en: Aaaaah, why can't I hold all these candies?!
ja: ああああ、どうしてこのお菓子、全部持てないの?!

key: Hello! Welcome to the Sweet Kiss Candy Shop!
en: Hello! Welcome to the Sweet Kiss Candy Shop!
ja: こんにちは! スイートキス・キャンディショップへようこそ!

key: We boast a wonderful array of succulent sweets guaranteed to bring a smile to your-- and your Pokémon's-- face, every day!
en: We boast a wonderful array of succulent sweets guaranteed to bring a smile to your-- and your Pokémon's-- face, every day!
ja: あなたと――そしてあなたのポケモンの――笑顔を、毎日きっと引き出す、素晴らしい極上スイーツの数々を取りそろえています!

key: We are also hiring new employees in many positions!
en: We are also hiring new employees in many positions!
ja: 各種ポジションで、新しい従業員も募集中です!

key: If you'd like to work with us, please visit our company headquarters at 9th and Saffron, or log on to our website and download the form.
en: If you'd like to work with us, please visit our company headquarters at 9th and Saffron, or log on to our website and download the form.
ja: 一緒に働きたい方は、9番街とサフロンの角にある本社までお越しいただくか、ウェブサイトから応募用紙をダウンロードしてください。

key: We boast a wondeful array of succulent sweets guaranteed to bring a smile to your-- and your Pokémon's-- face, every day!
en: We boast a wondeful array of succulent sweets guaranteed to bring a smile to your-- and your Pokémon's-- face, every day!
ja: あなたと――そしてあなたのポケモンの――笑顔を、毎日きっと引き出す、素晴らしい極上スイーツの数々を取りそろえています!

key: This new employee though...
en: This new employee though...
ja: でも、この新入社員……

key: Does he ever chill out?
en: Does he ever chill out?
ja: 落ち着くことってあるのかな?

key: I heard that if you give your Pokémon candy, they'll like you more.
en: I heard that if you give your Pokémon candy, they'll like you more.
ja: ポケモンにお菓子をあげると、もっと懐いてくれるって聞いたよ。

key: Makes sense; if someone gave ME candy, I'd like them more!
en: Makes sense; if someone gave ME candy, I'd like them more!
ja: 納得だね、あたしだってお菓子もらったら、その人のこともっと好きになるもん!

key: That's true for all types of candy except EXP Candy!
en: That's true for all types of candy except EXP Candy!
ja: それって、けいけんアメ以外の全種類のお菓子に当てはまるんだって!

key: Maybe it's a manufacturing issue? I just don't feel it.
en: Maybe it's a manufacturing issue? I just don't feel it.
ja: 製造上の問題なのかな? 何も感じないんだよね。

key: Hello! Would you like to play Sweet Kiss' exclusive promotion challenge for a chance at a fantastic prize?
en: Hello! Would you like to play Sweet Kiss' exclusive promotion challenge for a chance at a fantastic prize?
ja: こんにちは! スイートキス限定のプロモーションチャレンジに挑戦して、素敵な景品をゲットしませんか?

key: Do you want to skip this tile puzzle?
en: Do you want to skip this tile puzzle?
ja: このタイルパズルをスキップしますか?

key: Excellent! All you have to do is arrange the tiles to form the proper picture. Rotate the tiles using the Ready Item key, and move them with the Action key.
en: Excellent! All you have to do is arrange the tiles to form the proper picture. Rotate the tiles using the Ready Item key, and move them with the Action key.
ja: 素晴らしい! タイルを並べ替えて、正しい絵を完成させるだけです。持ち物キーでタイルを回転させ、決定キーで動かしてください。

key: We have a winner!
en: We have a winner!
ja: 当選者です!

key: And for your prize, we present your very own Sweet Kiss official mascot, Swirlix!
en: And for your prize, we present your very own Sweet Kiss official mascot, Swirlix!
ja: 景品として、スイートキスの公式マスコット、ペロッパフを差し上げます!

key: Well, take your time! This promotion won't end anytime soon!
en: Well, take your time! This promotion won't end anytime soon!
ja: ゆっくりどうぞ! このプロモーションはすぐには終わりませんので!

key: Oh? Any time!
en: Oh? Any time!
ja: あら? いつでもどうぞ!

key: No, I won't get down!
en: No, I won't get down!
ja: いやよ、降りないから!

key: You can't tell me to get down when you're not down yourself!
en: You can't tell me to get down when you're not down yourself!
ja: 自分が降りてないくせに、あたしに降りろなんて言えないでしょ!

key: RAZZY: Listen, I'm excited too! But we can't just stand on the shelves all day!
en: RAZZY: Listen, I'm excited too! But we can't just stand on the shelves all day!
ja: ラジー: あのね、あたしだってワクワクしてるよ! でも一日中棚の上に立ってるわけにはいかないの!

key: Will you get down with me now?
en: Will you get down with me now?
ja: 一緒に降りてくれる?
